description: This file defines the DisruptorCommandExecutor class, which implements command execution using the LMAX Disruptor pattern, including handling command events, routing, and middleware invocation.

classes.name: DisruptorCommandExecutor
classes.description: Implements command execution using the Disruptor pattern, manages event publishing and shutdown.

classes.name: DisruptorCommandExecutor.CommandEvent
classes.description: Represents a command event containing the command and its associated future.

classes.name: DisruptorCommandExecutor.CompleteableCommandEventHandler
classes.description: Handles command events, applies middleware, routes commands, and completes futures.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a command by publishing it to the disruptor and returns a supplier for the result.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Publishes a command to the ring buffer and returns the associated event.

methods.name: onEvent
methods.description: Processes a command event, invoking middleware, routing, and completing the future.
